property_summary: For any caller passed into assertionDisputedCallback, the reference contract never emits PriceRequestAdded as a result of that call (because requestPrice is only callable by the optimistic asserter), while the mutant allows arbitrary callers to trigger requestPrice and thus can cause PriceRequestAdded to be observed after assertionDisputedCallback for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so requestPrice can be called by anyone, changing whether PriceRequestAdded is emitted after calls (i.e., public caller control over emissions).
